subject: chemistry
note: IGCSE-only concepts (new notes) and the IGCSE spec points that join existing GCSE concepts. Merged with gcse-chemistry.json by conceptMap.ts. Each IGCSE spec point is primary in exactly one concept.

concepts.title: Diffusion and gas behaviour
concepts.scope: How temperature and pressure change the volume of a gas, and how diffusion and relative molecular mass are explained by particle motion.

concepts.title: Oxidation numbers and redox agents
concepts.scope: Using oxidation numbers (Roman numerals and rules) to spot oxidation and reduction and the agents involved, and redox colour changes with manganate(VII) and iodide.

concepts.title: The Contact process
concepts.scope: Making sulfur trioxide for sulfuric acid: sources of sulfur dioxide and oxygen, the equilibrium equation and the typical conditions and catalyst.

concepts.title: Acidic, basic and amphoteric oxides
concepts.scope: Classifying oxides as acidic, basic or amphoteric from metallic and non-metallic character, with their reactions with acids and bases.

concepts.title: Extraction of iron: the blast furnace
concepts.scope: How iron is extracted from hematite in the blast furnace: coke, carbon monoxide, limestone and slag, with the equations.

concepts.title: Substances in natural water
concepts.scope: Why distilled water is used in experiments, and the beneficial and harmful substances found in water from natural sources.

concepts.title: Structural formulae, isomers and naming
concepts.scope: Writing structural formulae, structural isomers (butane, butene, propanol) and naming and drawing unbranched alkanes, alkenes, alcohols, carboxylic acids and esters.

concepts.title: Alkanes: substitution with chlorine
concepts.scope: Why alkanes are generally unreactive, and the photochemical substitution reaction of an alkane with chlorine and its products.

concepts.title: Laboratory apparatus and key terms
concepts.scope: Choosing apparatus to measure time, temperature, mass and volume, judging methods, and the terms solvent, solute, solution, saturated solution, residue and filtrate.

concepts.title: Solubility and solubility curves
concepts.scope: What solubility means in g per 100 g of solvent, how to plot and read solubility curves, and how to measure the solubility of a solid at a set temperature.

concepts.title: Oxygen in air and combustion of elements
concepts.scope: How the percentage of oxygen in air is found by experiment, how magnesium, hydrogen and sulfur burn in oxygen, and carbon dioxide from heating metal carbonates.

concepts.title: Heat energy change and molar enthalpy
concepts.scope: Calculating heat energy change from temperature change using Q = mcΔT, and converting it to a molar enthalpy change in kJ/mol.
